top_signals.title: Hydro-Quebec Forced to Import More Power After Deals With US Utilities
top_signals.summary: Hydro-Quebec, a Canadian renewable-energy powerhouse with major US export contracts, is stretching an investment plan worth C$200 billion ($143 billion) by six years to 2041. Until then, it anticipates potentially being a net importer of electricity.

top_signals.title: Majority of London’s Thames Bridges Are in Poor Condition
top_signals.summary: Over half of London’s bridges across the River Thames are in ‘poor’ or ‘very poor’ condition, the worst possible ratings, with the crossing in Chelsea deteriorating after heavy vehicles were recently diverted from a nearby crossing.
